reuse.why: The rule change is made inside the existing getScheduledAmount helper and keeps using getApproxNumberThreshold for the tolerance, so every consumer picks it up.

duplication.why: No logic is copied; the new branch is simpler than the one it replaces (Math.min and subtracting the threshold).

placement.why: The change lives in shared/schedules.ts where the tree already centralises the expected schedule amount.

scope.why: Only the helper, its tests and a release note are touched.

maintainability.why: A two-line change in one shared definition, with tests covering entry order, zero-spanning ranges, approximate income and inverse.

bypasses_abstraction.where: none; all callers continue through getScheduledAmount
